an5.294-302:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato nigaṇṭho … muṇḍasāvako … jaṭilako … paribbājako … māgaṇḍiko … tedaṇḍiko … āruddhako … gotamako … devadhammiko yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an5.294-302:1.3: pāṇātipātī hoti adinnādāyī hoti abrahmacārī hoti musāvādī hoti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti
an5.294-302:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato devadhammiko yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ nirayeti.
